name: among us design final
design:
A clean sci-fi environment in a flat 2D Flash animation style, matching the original Among Us game aesthetic.

Scene:
spaceship interior corridor with a sliding door opening to an infected area

Character fidelity (CRITICAL):
- EXACT original Among Us crewmate design
- simple capsule-shaped body (rounded top, flat feet)
- NO arms, NO fingers, NO joints
- small backpack only
- no clothing details, no suit seams, no mechanical parts
- minimal design, smooth silhouette
- proportions identical to the original game
- visor is a simple glossy oval (light blue gradient with subtle highlight)
- no added realism, no anatomy, no deformation (except zombie damage when specified)

Composition:
- cinematic over-the-shoulder camera angle
- foreground character seen from behind (yellow crewmate)
- doorway centered as a framing device
- strong depth: foreground / door frame / background horde
- perspective similar to a close-up cinematic shot (NOT wide isometric)
- layout must feel natural and readable

Characters:
- Among Us crewmates (yellow, red, etc.)
- simple capsule-shaped bodies
- no visible arms
- smooth and minimal silhouette
- interacting naturally (observing, reacting, operating device)

Zombie characters:
- Among Us crewmates mutated into zombies
- base shape MUST remain Among Us silhouette
- torn bodies, broken edges, open mouths with sharp teeth
- exaggerated horror features BUT still cartoon
- no realistic anatomy, no human muscle structure

Line style (VERY IMPORTANT):
- thick, uniform black outlines
- vector-perfect linework
- smooth Bézier curve lines (no wobble, no jitter)
- no broken edges, no sketch lines
- consistent stroke width across entire image
- clean SVG-style paths
- anti-aliased edges, crisp and sharp
- no hand-drawn effect
- no roughness, no noise in lines

Color:
- slightly desaturated palette
- controlled saturation (no neon, no oversaturation)
- flat color fills with minimal soft shading
- no gradients except subtle visor highlight
- no texture, no grain, no dithering

Lighting:
- flat lighting
- evenly lit scene
- no realistic shadows or lighting effects

Environment design:
- simplified geometric sci-fi structures
- clean panels, sliding doors, pipes, consoles
- functional layout that supports the scene (door = focal point)
- props must feel intentionally designed
- avoid clutter, keep readability high

Depth:
- clear foreground / midground / background separation
- use scale and overlap (NOT shading) to express depth
- doorway acts as main depth frame

Style:
- flat cel-shaded 2D
- vector illustration look
- Flash / Toon Boom animation style
- mobile game asset quality
- clean UI-like design language

Surface quality:
- smooth flat surfaces
- no brush texture
- no painterly rendering
- clean digital fill

Avoid:
- realistic anatomy
- complex suit design
- extra limbs or joints
- uneven outlines
- sketchy lines
- grain / noise / texture
- realistic shading
- complex rendering
- messy composition
